source.title: Hinterlands Mission X: Star Lotus
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane and collect Star Lotus from within the Nightmare Incursions. We can harness its magic to reverse the damage. You will need the assistance of an herbalist.
source.objective: Gather 10 Star Lotus in the Hinterlands Nightmare Incursions and return to Field Captain Korlian.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
